book.name: 2 Koronti
book.title: Pwoo ɗevǝl dǝ Pool ran nen Koronti mo

content: Shin mBiizuum ShiReɓet Kǝ Pǝtuup
Ɗyemnaa mo, muu reɓet kǝ wu man pwoo nkaa ɗeret ɗe Naan wur shin nǝ Ekǝlisya ɗe mo nyil mMasidoniya.

Koo ɗe ɗi mo kǝ cam mo shi jeel ɗenaat, kǝ mo nkaa shwaajeel mǝ mbii mo zak, bǝ jir kǝsǝ, retnyit fur nǝ ɗes. Ɓǝ nǝ le kǝ mo cìn mbii ɗeret mbǝɗe mo shin mbii fur mo shi zuum, koo ɗe baa mo kǝ mee mbii ɗes kas.
Wen man azeen nǝ, mbii ɗe mo cin nǝ a nciit kǝ ɓal fur, har nǝ met ɓal fur, mbǝɗe mo shin nǝ a shi reɓet kǝ pǝtuup fur mo.
Moo ɗang pǝ mun ɗes hakyeng nǝ, mu shin pee nɗun kǝ mo leɗun mɓut nen ɗe mon ncìn ɓam mbǝ nen Jesu mo sǝ.
Har mo shin mbii mo ɗes met mbii ɗe mu lepan. Ɗang mo shee shin a pǝtuup fur mo nDaa, kǝ mun zak, nciit kǝ mbii ɗe Naan kǝ rǝɓet kǝ mo cìn.
Kaaɗe mu naa nǝ ret, bǝ mu lep Titus dǝm pee wun ɗi, mbǝɗe ɗi a wur shee cìn ɗak ɗeret desǝ nǝ nɗǝǝn wun, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ a wur nsǝǝt sekyeen kǝ ɗak nǝ.

Wun kǝ sekyeen nɗǝǝn koo a mbii ɗeɗangyii, har nɗǝǝn shinzeen, kǝ satpwoo, kǝ man, kǝ gung mbii mo ɗes, kǝ wal ɗi wun kǝ nǝ mbǝ mun. Nǝ ret kǝ wu sekyeen kǝ cìn ɗak ɗeret mǝ shin zuum shi pǝtuup mǝndong.
Baa wen kǝ le a mee wàar pee wun ɗi kas, ɗang nǝ a mbǝ kám gung ɗe nwun, mbǝkǝ wen man ɗi azeen nǝ, wal ɗe wun kǝ nǝ, mbǝ ɓam niyee mo, nǝ azeen.
Mbǝɗe wun kǝ man ɗeret mu Daa fun Jesu Kristi, koo ɗe gyet wur a ngulong, jir kǝsǝ, bǝ wur lekáa wur ɗee kaa ngujeel sǝ mbǝ wun. Mbǝkǝ nɗǝǝn jeel wur nǝ, ɓe wu ɗee ɗi a nenlong mo.
A pan mǝnǝ nkaa mbii nǝ nɗesǝ, nǝn nret kǝ yaksǝ bǝ wu sǝǝt koor mbii ɗe gyet wuu yaa cìn nǝ doontoom sǝ. Gyet a wun shee shin mbii, kǝ wun kǝ pǝtuup mu shin mbii hakyeng.
Nǝ ret kǝ wu kyes koor ɗak nǝ shi reɓet kǝ pǝtuup fuu mo, nciit kǝ ɓal fuu, kaaɗe gyet wu shee cin nǝ sǝ.
Katɗang ɓe mee gurum kǝ pǝtuup ɗe mǝ shin mbiizuum, ɓe Naan nlap mbiizuum kǝ ngwe nǝ nciit kǝ mbii ɗe ngwe nǝ shin nNaan. Baa Naan wur ntang a mbii ɗi ngwe nǝ nnǝ kas.
Baa wen sat pwoo mǝnǝ a mbǝkǝ pak gurum mo nook shin mbiizuum, mbǝkǝ nǝ toon ɗi wuwun kas.

Ɗang a mbǝkǝ mo le mbii mo ɗee ɗin ndǝre, bǝ wu ɓam mo yaksǝ, shi mbii kǝkat fuu mo, mbǝɗe baa mo kǝ mee mbii kas. Mbǝkǝ katɗang parpuus ɗe wu táa njeel, ɓe mo ɓam wun ɗi zak. Ɗesinǝ nǝ a mbǝkǝ mo shwap mbii mo ɗi nciit-nciit.
Kaaɗe mo kǝ ten ran nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt haal kǝ Naan sǝ nǝnee, <<Ngwe ɗewur chak ɗes, ɓe baa nǝn njar ɗes kaa wur kas, kǝ ngwe ɗewur chak lee, ɓe baa nǝn njar kat kaa wur kas.>>
Titus Kǝ Shaarmwaan Wur Mo
wen pǝlang Naan, ɗe wur lepan nɗǝǝn pǝtuup kǝ Titus, mbǝkǝ wur ɓam wun ɗi, kaaɗe wen kǝn cìn wun sǝ.
Baa wur lap ii a mbǝ ɗang fun ɓejee ɗak kas, amma wur kǝ fes lepan wur, mbǝkǝ wur dǝm pee wun shi pan mukáa wur.
Muu lep wur dǝm pee wun ɗi ashak kǝ ɗyemnǝǝn fun ɗi gurum moo fes shin ɗeɗes nwur, mbǝ satpwoo kǝ Naan nɗǝǝn Ekǝlisya mo jir.
Baa a mǝnǝ ɓejee ɗak kas, amma Ekǝlisya mo bǝlep wur, mbǝkǝ wur dǝm ɗi ashak kǝ mun, mbǝ dǝm kǝ mbiizuum ɗe muu shin nǝ, mbǝ le Daa a ɗeɗes, kǝ kám agaak nǝ, mun kǝ pǝtuup ɗe nǝ a mǝ ɓam zak.
Baa muu reɓet kǝ mee gurum fǝlǝp mun nkaa mbiizuum ɗesǝ, ɗe gurum moo shin nǝ shi pǝtuup mǝndong, ɗe mun nkaa shin nǝ sǝ kas.
Mbii ɗe muu reɓet nɗesǝ, kǝ wu cìn mbii mo ɗi ndǝre-ndǝre, baa a ntoom kǝ Daa ɓejee ɗak kas, har kǝ ntoom kǝ gurum mo jir zak.

Muu lep ɗyemnǝǝn fun ashak kǝ mo zak. Mun kǝ cam ɗyemnǝǝn fun wur yit mo ɗes, ɓe mǝ kat wur a nguɗak zam nɗǝǝn ar mo shinǝ-shinǝ. Yaksǝ bǝ wur cìn ɗak nǝ waa met ɗeyam zak. Wur kǝ cìn ɗak ɗeret nǝ ɗes mbǝ ɓam wun.
Titus wur a shaarmwaan fen, ɗewur cìn ɗak ashak kǝ wen mbǝ ɓam wun zak. Mpee ɗyemnǝǝn fun desǝ mo, ɓe mo a nen ɗe Ekǝlisya mo lep mo, mbǝkǝ mo le sǝm kǝ Kristi ɗi a ɗeɗes.
Mbǝmǝnǝ, ɓe wu kám wal fuu mmo, mbǝkǝ Ekǝlisya nǝ mo man ɗi azeen-nzeen nǝ, joom ɗe mu can nǝ mbǝ wun, nǝ a ndǝre azeen-nzeen.
